title: Raiju thunder beast of Japanese folklore

tellings.quote: character in Japanese folklore known as the Rayu, which is a thunder beast that becomes activated during thunderstorms.

plain: Japanese folklore tells of the Raiju, "a thunder beast that becomes activated during thunderstorms," according to the researcher Geoffrey Drumm, who pronounces it "Rayu." Drumm brings it up with Michels while talking about the pyramids, without naming a source, and does not say here what he draws from it.
